{{Top|leg}}
A '''joysmasher''' was a member of a criminal gang whose sole intent was to hotwire the [[Speeder/Legends|speeders]] of the wealthy and steal them. They would then ride around in them before smashing them in barriers and energy pylons for fun. [[World Devastator]] [[Calibration Engineer]] [[Deppo]] was a joysmasher in his childhood on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]].<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>
